cash_sessions_closed_ck.name: cash_sessions_closed_ck
cash_sessions_closed_ck.value: "cash_sessions"."status" = 'OPEN' or ("cash_sessions"."actual_closing" is not null and "cash_sessions"."expected_closing" is not null and "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is not null)

expenses_sign_ck.name: expenses_sign_ck
expenses_sign_ck.value: ("expenses"."reversal_of_id" is null and "expenses"."amount" > 0) or ("expenses"."reversal_of_id" is not null and "expenses"."amount" < 0)

payments_target_ck.name: payments_target_ck
payments_target_ck.value: ("payments"."sale_id" is not null) <> ("payments"."order_id" is not null)

supplier_payments_sign_ck.name: supplier_payments_sign_ck
supplier_payments_sign_ck.value: ("supplier_payments"."kind" = 'PAYMENT' and "supplier_payments"."amount" > 0) or ("supplier_payments"."kind" = 'REVERSAL' and "supplier_payments"."amount" < 0 and "supplier_payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null)
